banner: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Keep production caller responses on the intended version while a separate candidate is compared; inspect response discrepancies and independent business-write/notification counters.

configuration.host: Direct local file; no application server
configuration.candidateVersion: The other version, never returned to the caller
configuration.shadowSink: Attempts one write and notification per request; suppresses both except in the explicitly unsafe synthetic fixture.
configuration.unknownFixture: Candidate effect attempts are suppressed, then the response is withheld. Known synthetic sink counters cannot establish response equality or live safety.
configuration.responseComparison: HTTP-like status plus business body fields, excluding handler-version metadata
configuration.storage: In-memory only; no persistence, timers, network traffic or external effects

coverage: Safe shadow with production v1 and v2
Matching response with unsafe duplicate business effects and notifications
Earlier unsafe history retained after later safe replay
Invalid profile, version, scenario, count and fields fail closed
Keyboard operation and complete Reset without form method shadowing
bdd.executionLimit: First-written Gherkin specification; no Cucumber execution is claimed.

tddRed.failureKind: 31 ERR_ASSERTION behavioral failures against a loadable model stub. No missing tool, import, package or module failure.
tddRed.normalization: Repository absolute path prefixes were removed; 60 trailing-whitespace runs were trimmed for git diff --check. Path-redacted pre-trim output is preserved losslessly in red-original.txt.gz; assertion details, durations and counts are unchanged.

iac.reason: SOURCE-only local synthetic lesson; no resources, management calls, credentials, registration, deployment or spend.

implementationAndRefactoring: Pure immutable replay model builds independent caller and candidate responses.
Shared field comparator reports changed/missing fields and unknown response evidence.
Explicit shadow sink separates attempted, suppressed and recorded effects.
Cumulative counts derive from retained deterministic batch observations; a later safe batch cannot erase duplicates.
Input validation and total-budget admission occur before any request is added.
State integrity is revalidated against the known fixture before replay or aggregation.
Local DOM rendering uses textContent, labeled native controls and a native form reset with non-shadowing control IDs.

browser.helperReadiness: Used only after the parent explicitly verified the implementation and granted its use; no tooling edits or dependency installation.

integratedBrowserBeforeHelperHandoff.lease: Explicitly requested, granted, RELEASE sent and acknowledged; no integrated lease remains.
integratedBrowserBeforeHelperHandoff.handoff: Switched to verified isolated-headless helper on parent instruction; no further integrated actions.

actualChecks: Keyboard tab order, visible focus, Enter replay, native form reset/submit methods
Safe v1 caller / v2 candidate and intended v2 caller / v1 candidate
Two visible candidate field discrepancies without changing caller tier or points
MATCH plus UNSAFE with duplicate writes and notifications
Later SAFE retains all earlier unsafe effect counts and rows
Missing candidate response remains UNKNOWN while production answers
Six invalid counts and an invalid profile preserve all counters/history
Keyboard Reset restores all defaults and clears every observation/counter
Restrictive local CSP, zero HTTP(S) resource/interaction requests and zero observed page errors

expectedAssertions: Intended v1/v2 always answers callers; candidate never replaces that response.
Safe shadow records zero candidate writes/notifications and one suppressed attempt of each per request.
Discrepant tier/points are reported separately without changing the caller response.
Unsafe replay can MATCH while producing two effects instead of one per request; verdict remains UNSAFE.
UNKNOWN is not treated as MATCH or evidence of live readiness.
Invalid input preserves all previous requests and counters.
Reset clears all observations and restores all four default controls.

cleanup.action: Reset, reload or close the tab; all application state is in-memory only.

evidenceBoundaries.paths: Repository-relative only; local absolute prefixes are removed from committed runner output.
